system.description:
Why respect knights when my potions can do anything that you can? —Justin Kuritzkes, Potion Seller Often sequestered in a lab, alchemists study the essence of creation. They are as curious as they are resourceful, and always have "just the thing for this."

The alchemist is a low-defense, high-damageand-utility blaster. It's recommended you stay Far from Enemies to use Alchemical Items.

  • Action: Use (Craft & Attack)
  • Move: Backline
  • Key Stat: Reason
  • Complexity: HHHHI
  • Training: Arcana, Craft, Medicine

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Alchemy
features.description:
Choose 4 Alchemical Items (p. 84) with a value no higher than (your Level × 50s). You only need 5s of Materials and Alchemy Tools equipped to Craft them.

You learn to Craft 1 other Alchemical Item this way every 3 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Catalyze
features.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk (p. 68), and can Craft Alchemical Items with the Use Action.

features.name: Eureka
features.description:
When you pass a Craft Check by 15 or more, you gain a Studied die (p. 19). The roll required to do so is decreased by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Alchemist: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Potency
features.description:
You have a +1 bonus to each of the damage and healing dice of your Alchemical Items, and they can Explode. This bonus increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Alchemist: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Mix
features.description: You can combine two Alchemical Items together with the Use Action by spending a Studied die, causing both Items to occur simultaneously when used. The combined Item goes inert at the start of your next Turn.

features.name: Prima Materia
features.description: You can spend a Studied die to Craft any Alchemical Item with a value as high as 10g without Materials.
